subject: EXP-003M-MAKER-FILL-REALITY-001

method.why_a_worktree: a clean checkout is the only thing that proves the published bytes survived Git; the working tree it was written in does not
method.network: the run downloaded the frozen 1-minute bars from Binance spot /api/v3/klines and 42 (symbol, UTC day) aggregate-trade archives from data.binance.vision; no cached copy from this host was used

defects_found_and_repaired.defect: a clean checkout rewrote SHA256SUMS.txt and every pinned artifact to CRLF (core.autocrlf=true), so sha256sum -c verified 0 of 18 and the experiment was reproducible only on the machine that wrote it
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: .gitattributes marks reports/ai-bots/EXP-003M-MAKER-FILL-REALITY-001/** -text, as the other digest-pinned trees already do
defects_found_and_repaired.verified: 18/18 in the clean worktree after the repair

defects_found_and_repaired.defect: 8 of 25 EXP-003M tests sealed a synthetic experiment, and seal() read EXP-003L's SHA256SUMS.txt, a tree that is not committed: the suite passed only where 003L happened to exist
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: the predecessor digest is provenance, not a precondition; the seal records NOT_PRESENT_IN_CHECKOUT instead of crashing
defects_found_and_repaired.verified: 25/25 in a worktree that never had EXP-003L

not_verified: no live order was placed and no fill is observed anywhere in this chain; the rehearsal proves the bytes, not the market
the 003L predecessor tree remains unpublished: its digests cannot be checked from a clean checkout by anyone
